Which statement explains why increasing the concentration of a reactant increases the rate
of reaction?
A
There is a higher percentage of successful collisions between particles.
B
The activation energy of the reaction decreases.
There is a higher percentage of collisions involving particles with energy greater than the
C
activation energy.
D
There are more collisions per second between particles.

options.label: A
options.text: There is a higher percentage of successful collisions between particles.

options.label: B
options.text: The activation energy of the reaction decreases.

options.label: D
options.text: There are more collisions per second between particles.
